text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くーん！
　
こっちこっちー！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Hey there. Glad to see you made it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やあ。
遅れずに来てくれてよかった。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: It's a big relief to have you with us, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンがいるなら、
わたしたちも安心だね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
It may have been just a coincidence,
but asking you to come along was the right call.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
偶然とはいえ、
キミに声をかけたのは正解だったな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
頑張るぞー！
